scope: Signed iOS Simulator product UI against the production database and its real RLS/RPC behavior through an explicitly authorized Mac-loopback Auth/PostgREST facade and SSH reverse tunnel

observations.retry: The first block was forced to fail before transport; the signed Simulator UI exposed its optimistic unblock state, restored the original block action with an error, and the same visible Retry control converged to a production block edge.
observations.nativeSurface: The app restored the authenticated surface through the explicitly forwarded loopback runtime, opened the peer profile from Chat, completed the shared retry flow and returned to the same conversation.

limits: Hosted Supabase Auth returned HTTP 402, so authentication and REST transport were supplied by the opt-in Mac-loopback facade while retaining the production database, RLS and RPC behavior.
The facade did not implement hosted Realtime and this focal report does not certify the hosted Auth/API gateway.

provenance.priorFailedAttempt: The first signed run completed cleanup but the safety XCTest launched the app without forwarding the authorized native-facade runtime, so the Chat host never mounted. Product SHA fcd23947 forwards the same three bounded launch values already used by the accepted follow-retry test and requires the authenticated chrome before opening Chat.
